notes: Parses to a plain object (default options: text trimmed, entities decoded, same-named siblings grouped into an array only when there are several); the adapter looks up category, product, price, tags and description, reading attributes with the @ prefix and text through the node's #text. The parser decodes entities itself and, by default, decodes them a second time in CDATA content (so a literal & in CDATA becomes &); the adapter passes revive.entities: false, which keeps the CDATA content as written while the underlying parser still decodes ordinary text and attributes.
